переезжать.gloss: to move (house), to relocate; to cross

meanings.note: Change one's place of residence. Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'езжать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to move (house), to relocate; to cross', paired with 'переехать'.

examples.text: Ну и что? Я всё равно переезжать собираюсь.
examples.trans: So what? I'm planning to move anyway.

examples.text: Переезжай ко мне в большую квартиру.
examples.trans: Move in with me into a big apartment.

meanings.en: in my opinion, to my mind
meanings.note: Parenthetical. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem '-моему').

examples.trans: In my opinion, this is disgusting!

meanings.note: Animate masculine noun. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лковник'). Derived noun with agent/object suffix '-ник'/'-щик'/'-чик'. Common masculine noun meaning 'colonel' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Так, полковник, успокойся. Зина, дай вилку.
examples.trans: Easy, Colonel, calm down. Zina, give me a fork.

помещаться.gloss: to fit in, to find room; to be located

meanings.en: to fit, to have enough room
meanings.note: In a space. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мещаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to fit in, to find room; to be located', paired with 'поместиться'.

examples.trans: In my opinion, you fit in just fine.

meanings.note: the person helped is in the dative: 'помогать маме' = to help mum

examples.text: Так, операцию продолжаем. Михаил Михайлович, помогайте Лаврову.
examples.trans: Right, the operation goes on. Mikhail Mikhailovich, give Lavrov your help.

meanings.note: + dative. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мочь'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to help', paired with 'помогать'.

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?

meanings.note: In потому что. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'тому').

examples.text: Я устал, потому что много работал.
examples.trans: I'm tired because I worked a lot.

meanings.note: Asks about the reason. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'чему').

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

прикрепить.gloss: to attach, to assign, to fasten

meanings.note: officially assign someone to a unit or group

Literal. Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'крепить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to attach, to assign, to fasten', paired with 'прикреплять'.

examples.text: Пусть он меня к вашей группе прикрепит!

examples.text: Пусть он меня к вашей группе прикрепит официально!
